title: Plan a stray-dog pickup route
summary: Stray animals are the #1 complaint to 311. Plan one van’s route through today’s reports.
details: Order today’s sightings into one route that starts and ends at the shelter and visits the newest, most-reported spots first.
data: Sighting reports with time + location, and the shelter’s location
reward: Interview with a Shipt engineering team

solutions.author: ari_s
solutions.approach: Hot spots (3+ reports) first, then a nearest-neighbor tour: always drive to the closest stop that is left.

solutions.author: maya_codes
solutions.approach: Priority queue by report age, then shortest path between stops.
